title: Transfer Case
text: Differential as a planetary bevel gear, 4 outputs, {Interpolation method} sets Method Flat; {Efficiency factors} sets the configuration, {Input ambient temperature} sets the create input port, {Input front axle torque split ratio, TrqSplitRatio} sets the create input port, {Input axle speed lock, SpdLock} sets the create input port, {Crown wheel (ring gear) located} sets the crown wheel connection To the left, {Carrier to drive shaft ratio, Ndiff} sets the ratio, {Carrier inertia, Jd} sets the inertia .1, {Carrier damping, bd} sets the damping 1e-3, {Axle 1 inertia, Jw1} sets the inertia .1, {Axle 1 damping, bw1} sets the damping 1e-3, {Axle 2 inertia, Jw2} sets the inertia .1, {Axle 2 damping, bw2} sets the damping 1e-3, {Axle 1 initial velocity, omegaw1o} sets the angular velocity, {Axle 2 initial velocity, omegaw2o} sets the angular velocity, {Constant efficiency factor, eta} sets the efficiency, {Efficiency lookup table, eta_tbl} sets the lookup table M -by- N -by, {Efficiency torque breakpoints, Trq_bpts} sets the torque breakpoints, {Efficiency speed breakpoints, omega_bpts} sets the speed breakpoints, {Efficiency temperature breakpoints, Temp_bpts} sets the temperature breakpoints, {Ambient temperature, Tamb}, {Front axle torque split ratio, TrqSplitRatio} and {Axle speed lock, SpdLock}. Values come from the instance.
